claim_boundary: 64 development events, unequal tiny capacities and four updates per model only validate interfaces/metric arithmetic. No model ranking, SNN adequacy, generalization, statistical significance or performance conclusion.

definitions.brier_normalized_zero_one: multiclass_brier_sum / 2; not divided by class count
definitions.calibration: raw softmax; no temperature or other calibration was fitted
definitions.top_label_ece_15_equal_width: sum count/N * abs(bin accuracy - mean top probability); [i/15,(i+1)/15), final bin includes 1
